title: Direction Recommendation
description: REPORT-stage ADVISORY artifact from the direction-decision-advisor seat: what the finished run's own evidence says about where to go next — DEEPEN (further down the same mechanism), BROADEN (same direction, wider search), PIVOT (the framing itself is wrong), or CONCLUDE (the question is answered well enough to stop). HARD design rule, mirroring idea_backlog: this is ADVICE, never a decision. It contains NO selected / chosen / bet / approved field, it never names a winning idea, and it never gates a stage. All FOUR options must be assessed every time with evidence for AND against, so the director can disagree cheaply; presenting only the favoured option is the failure this artifact exists to prevent. `unresolved` is where the advisor says plainly that this run's evidence cannot separate two options — a more useful answer than a confident guess.

recommendation_id.description: Short unique identifier, e.g. DR-001. Non-blank.

recommended.description: The advisor's recommendation. ADVICE ONLY — the director decides, and may pick any of the four (or none).

confidence.description: How well this run's evidence separates the recommended option from the others. Low is a legitimate and common answer.

rationale.description: Why this option, in the director's plain language.

options.description: All four options, each assessed exactly once with evidence on both sides. Exactly four: an advisor that silently drops an option it dislikes is the thing this contract forbids.

supporting_evidence.description: What the run actually shows in favour. Write 'none found' as the observation when a side genuinely has nothing — never an empty list.

opposing_evidence.description: What argues against this option, on the same terms as supporting_evidence.

trigger_met.description: The advisor's honest read of whether this option's precondition holds.

unresolved.description: What could not be assessed this run, and what would settle it. Naming an unmeasurable difference beats inventing a metric to justify a recommendation.

evidence_ref.description: Anti-slop: the run artifacts this recommendation was derived from.
